notes.title: Steam Winter Sale starts today!
notes.content:
Get ready for some serious savings & expansion of your Steam library because the Steam Winter Sale is here! From now until January 3rd, you can snag some of the best games out there at discounted prices. And we've got some amazing deals for you to check out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/9362764c70ce26bbad55e98a0d335c901c31172b.png[/img]

First up, we've got the amazing BarnFinders, which is on a whopping 50% discount. And if you're looking for even more exposure on Uncle Billy, the Amerykan Dream DLC is also on a 50% discount. But that's not all - if you want to take your BarnFinders experience to the truly next level, grab the BarnFinders VR on a -40% sale.

But if you're in the mood for something a little different, check out Accident - a game all about puzzle-solving car crashes. It's on a -50% discount and is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end.

And last but not least, don't miss out on Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment, which is on a -30% discount. This game is a must-have for any fan of science fiction and is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat.

Don't miss out on these amazing deals during the Steam Winter Sale. Stock up on all your favorite games and save big while you can!
